FAQ

Read more

Orders and Payment:

Which materials are used in INYA New York bags?

Prioritizing quality and durability, INYA New York typically uses high-quality synthetic leather, fabric, and chain accessories in its bags. This ensures they are both stylish and long-lasting.

How can I track my order?

After completing your order, a confirmation email along with shipping and tracking details will be sent to your email address. You can easily track your package using this information.

How much is the shipping fee and how long does delivery take?

The shipping fee may vary depending on your total order amount, delivery region, and any promotional periods. In general, once your order is confirmed, it is handed over to the shipping company within 1-3 business days. Delivery then usually takes 2-5 business days, depending on your location.

What are the conditions for returns and exchanges?

You can request a return or exchange within 14 days of receiving the product, provided it has not been used and remains in its original packaging. For detailed information, please review the Return and Exchange Policy page on our website.

What payment methods are available?

Our website accepts various secure payment methods, including credit cards, debit cards, MasterCard, Visa, and Iyzico. Depending on promotions, installment options may also be available.

How can I request a product that is out of stock?

Our inventory is constantly updated. If the product you’re looking for is out of stock, you can leave your email address through the “Stock Alert” option on the product page. We’ll notify you when it becomes available again.
